Thanks Carly — this is helpful. A couple items for clarification before we lock times: 

1) Simultaneous interpretation: we plan to have two booths for simultaneous translation. Can you confirm booth footprint and whether we can reserve the adjacent breaker panel for an isolated PDU? If not, we need to schedule a vendor PDU drop.

2) Network/VLAN for AV: our AV partner will bring a managed switch and request a dedicated VLAN and two static IPs for camera systems. Is that request supported on the house network? If you require a formal request ticket, please let us know the form/link.

3) Freight elevator reservation: the keynote rehearsal runs from 14:00–17:00 on May 11. Can we shift heavy load-in to 18:30–22:30 to give the rehearsal runway? That would slightly compress the window but avoids interrupting rehearsals.

4) Parking passes: we need 2 truck passes and 4 vendor staff day-parking passes. Please confirm when/where we pick these up.

I'll attach a draft internal ops timeline (revised_timeline.xlsx) for your reference — it shows crew arrival times and stage access requests. Can you confirm vendor staging room C can fit a 2U portable rack plus three pelican cases?

Appreciate it — can loop in our AV lead if helpful.

Best,

David / Carly —

Quick technical clarifications from AV Solutions based on your notes and site map: 

- Booth footprint: two ISO-3 booths fit in the marked area but need 120v/20A per booth for interpretation consoles. If venue can't provide we will bring a small PDU but need a dedicated circuit.
- Vendor staging room C: 2U portable rack + three pelican cases OK, but we recommend 6 ft of clear aisle for cable run.
- We will bring a managed 24-port PoE switch for cameras and comms. A /30 (two static IPs) is fine; an isolated VLAN is preferred. If you can provision that, please share the ticket or admin contact.
- Rack/time: recommend we start rack staging at 19:00 on May 11 to allow a full hour for patching before soundcheck.

Attaching our updated rider with power and NTP requirements (av_rider_v2.pdf). Also: can venue provide a single point of contact for on-site network admin (name + cell) so we can avoid delays pulling a ticket during load-in?

Thanks,
